title: Urban Planning And Sustainable Development
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a rational, systematic approach to making policy choices in the public sector."
Public policy analysis is a rational, systematic approach to making policy choices in the public sector.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to the personal and societal assets, rules and processes, physical boundaries of places etc."
Social sustainability refers to the personal and societal assets, rules and processes, physical boundaries of places etc.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a sealed chamber in which there is no oxygen."
The digester is a sealed chamber in which there is no oxygen.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ means maximising a hedonic value measuring all the affected individuals' ‗pleasure' or ‗happiness'."
The utilitarian public interest means maximising a hedonic value measuring all the affected individuals' ‗pleasure' or ‗happiness'.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is considered to be an unplanned outgrowth of urban centres along the periphery of the cities, along highways, along the road connecting a city, etc."
Sprawl is considered to be an unplanned outgrowth of urban centres along the periphery of the cities, along highways, along the road connecting a city, etc.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are defined as those whose ownership is vested in private individuals, families, and lands under customary tenancies."
Private lands are defined as those whose ownership is vested in private individuals, families, and lands under customary tenancies.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the perfect opportunity for a community to do so."
Integrated community sustainability planning is the perfect opportunity for a community to do so.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a relevant dimension for anybody, not least for urban activities."
Energy security is a relevant dimension for anybody, not least for urban activities.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a course that looks to the future as a powerful tool that helps to successfully achieve the aspirations of cities."
Principles of Urban Design is a course that looks to the future as a powerful tool that helps to successfully achieve the aspirations of cities.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an important driver to environmental change and it is not the only urban-related influence."
Urbanisation is an important driver to environmental change and it is not the only urban-related influence.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the holistic approach that can fulfil this need."
Urban ecosystems analysis is the holistic approach that can fulfil this need.
